ledger.x: c. 1335: Sine is founded by Guelowar migrants. Infobox "Established: ca. 1335"; Maysa Wali fled Kaabu "after a battle in 1335" in Gravrand's oral tradition, but "the actual foundation date is unclear" and Becker places the story in 1865-67. The Maad a Sinig page dates the Guelowar kings "between 1350 and 1969". [Fix…
1887: the French conquer Senegal and Sine loses its independence.
1887: end of the Kingdom of Sine as a state; the maad a sinig title continues without sovereignty to 3 August 1969.

wars.name: Maba's invasion of Sine
wars.outcome: In 1866 Maba invaded Sine and burned Diakhao; on 18 July 1867 he was defeated and killed at Fandane-Thiouthioune (the Battle of Somb) by Sine's army.
